name: @variance-authority/example-tribunal
description: A third-party storefront, read as routes and as stories, reviewed in a tribunal.

scripts.app:build: npm --prefix app run build && npm --prefix app run build-storybook
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:assets && wrangler deploy --config deploy/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply variance-tribunal-example --remote --config deploy/wrangler.jsonc
